name: amazon_fire_tv_ads-mcp
display_name: Amazon Fire TV / Prime Video Streaming TV Ads MCP
description: Amazon Fire TV / Prime Video Streaming TV Ads (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, update_budge

platform_mcp_amazon_fire_tv_ads_client_i.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_FIRE_TV_ADS_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_amazon_fire_tv_ads_client_i.description: Login with Amazon client id of the app approved for the Amazon Ads API; also sent as the Amazon-Advertising-API-ClientId header.

platform_mcp_amazon_fire_tv_ads_client_s.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_FIRE_TV_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_amazon_fire_tv_ads_client_s.description: The LWA client secret (form body of the refresh_token grant).

platform_mcp_amazon_fire_tv_ads_refresh_.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_FIRE_TV_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_amazon_fire_tv_ads_refresh_.description: LWA refresh token from the advertiser's consent (scope advertising::campaign_management); the runtime mints hourly access tokens from it at https://api.amazon.com/auth/o2/token.

platform_mcp_amazon_fire_tv_ads_api_host.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_FIRE_TV_ADS_API_HOST
platform_mcp_amazon_fire_tv_ads_api_host.description: Regional Amazon Ads API host: advertising-api.amazon.com (North America), advertising-api-eu.amazon.com (Europe) or advertising-api-fe.amazon.com (Far East).

platform_mcp_amazon_fire_tv_ads_profile_.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_FIRE_TV_ADS_PROFILE_ID
platform_mcp_amazon_fire_tv_ads_profile_.description: Advertising profile id of the advertiser running Sponsored TV (from GET /v2/profiles), sent as the Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope header.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v2/profiles/{profileId}: the configured profile {profileId, countryCode, currencyCode, timezone, accountInfo {id, type, name, marketplaceStringId}}.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /v2/profiles (apiProgram=campaign, accessLevel=edit by default): one profile per advertiser and marketplace in the configured region. `id` is the profileId used as the Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope; country is raw.countryCode.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: Sponsored TV (Fire TV / Prime Video streaming TV ads) POST /st/campaigns/list with media type application/vnd.stCampaign.v1+json and {maxResults, stateFilter: {include: [status]}} (ENABLED, PAUSED, ARCHIVED). The advertiser is the configured profile_id (Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope); account_id is not sent. `budget` is the DAILY budget. Only the first page is returned (nextToken paging).

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: PUT /st/campaigns {campaigns: [{campaignId, budgetSettings: {budget: {budgetValue: {amount, budgetCurrencyCode}, recurrenceType: DAILY}}}]}: changes a daily budget that is spent on streaming TV ads. The API answers 207 with campaigns.success[] / campaigns.error[]; a rejected update is reported as invalid_input.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: PUT /st/campaigns {campaigns: [{campaignId, state: PAUSED|ENABLED}]}. Resuming restarts spending. A rejected update (campaigns.error only) is reported as invalid_input.
